explication: NerdSoloMiner is ESP32 firmware for solo Bitcoin mining, with configurable Wi-Fi and pool settings, mining/status displays, and support for multiple boards. Its documented workflow is to configure Wi-Fi and a Bitcoin address, connect to a Stratum pool, process mining work, and monitor results through the device screens. The graph preserves the documented screen and hardware branches. Several runtime files were not sampled, so their internal links are omitted or marked unverified rather than inferred.
